4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const canvas=document.querySelector('#game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),wrap=document.querySelector('#wrap');
const NX=19,NY=15,buildings=[],weapons={meteor:{cost:18,r:2.55,name:'Meteora',color:'#ff9b61'},storm:{cost:12,r:2.2,name:'Tempesta',color:'#8deafa'},vortex:{cost:25,r:3.4,name:'Vortice',color:'#bd91ff'},nova:{cost:35,r:4.7,name:'Nova',color:'#ffe28a'}};
let selected='meteor',energy=100,score=0,damage=0,combo=1,lastHit=0,lastTick=performance.now(),effects=[],particles=[],pointer=null,soundOn=false,audio=null,geometry={};
let seed=8172;const rand=()=>{seed=(seed*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296};
for(let y=0;y<NY;y++)for(let x=0;x<NX;x++)if(rand()>.16){let type=rand();let h=type>.94?160:type>.78?125:70+rand()*67;buildings.push({x,y,h,max:h,hp:1,w:.77+rand()*.16,d:.75+rand()*.16,shade:Math.floor(rand()*5),kind:type>.88?'spire':type>.72?'wide':'tower',seed:rand()*8})}
const total=buildings.length;
function resize(){let r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*d);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*d);canvas.style.width=r.width+'px';canvas.style.height=r.height+'px';ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);geometry={w:r.width,h:r.height,sx:Math.min(27,(r.width-32)/(NX+NY)),sy:Math.min(14,(r.height-98)/(NX+NY+9)),cx:r.width/2,cy:r.height*.59};geometry.sx=Math.min(geometry.sx,geometry.sy*2);geometry.sy=geometry.sx*.51;geometry.cy=Math.min(r.height*.62,r.height-(NX+NY)*geometry.sy/2-32)}
function project(x,y){let g=geometry;return [g.cx+(x-(NX-1)/2-y+(NY-1)/2)*g.sx,g.cy+(x-(NX-1)/2+y-(NY-1)/2)*g.sy]}
function path(points){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(points[0][0],points[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(points[i][0],points[i][1]);ctx.closePath()}
function diamond(x,y,dx,dy){return [[x,y-dy],[x+dx,y],[x,y+dy],[x-dx,y]]}
function draw(now){let {w,h,sx,sy}=geometry;ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
let bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);bg.addColorStop(0,'#111a30');bg.addColorStop(.52,'#17243a');bg.addColorStop(1,'#11192a');ctx.fillStyle=bg;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
for(let i=0;i<60;i++){let xx=(i*173.7%w),yy=(i*91.3%Math.max(1,h*.63));ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(202,220,255,${.12+(i%4)*.06})`;ctx.fillRect(xx,yy,1,1)}
// distant skyline
for(let i=0;i<22;i++){let x=i*w/19-10,base=h*.49,bh=24+(i*37%83),bw=14+(i*13%27);ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#25324a':'#202d43';ctx.fillRect(x,base-bh,bw,bh);ctx.fillStyle='#ffcb7833';for(let j=0;j<3;j++)ctx.fillRect(x+4+j*6,base-bh+8,2,3)}
// city platform and subtle street diamonds
const corners=[[0,0],[NX,0],[NX,NY],[0,NY]].map(p=>project(p[0]-.5,p[1]-.5));path(corners);ctx.fillStyle='#253344';ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#5e718455';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
for(let y=0;y<=NY;y+=2)for(let x=0;x<=NX;x+=2){let p=project(x-.5,y-.5);ctx.strokeStyle='#71859a15';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);let q=project(Math.min(NX,x+2)-.5,y-.5);ctx.lineTo(q[0],q[1]);q=project(x-.5,Math.min(NY,y+2)-.5);ctx.lineTo(q[0],q[1]);ctx.stroke()}
const sorted=[...buildings].sort((a,b)=>(a.x+a.y)-(b.x+b.y)||a.y-b.y);
for(const b of sorted){const [x,y]=project(b.x,b.y),dx=sx*b.w*.46,dy=sy*b.d*.46,ht=Math.max(2,b.h*b.hp),top=diamond(x,y-ht,dx,dy),base=diamond(x,y,dx,dy);let pal=[['#314766','#263954','#49647e'],['#38425e','#29334d','#515b76'],['#31565e','#24464e','#47747a'],['#4a455d','#39354d','#625875'],['#45505f','#333e50','#5d6a78']][b.shade];
path([top[1],top[2],base[2],base[1]]);ctx.fillStyle=pal[0];ctx.fill();path([top[2],top[3],base[3],base[2]]);ctx.fillStyle=pal[1];ctx.fill();path(top);ctx.fillStyle=ht<8?'#4a4b4c':pal[2];ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#9bb7c533';ctx.lineWidth=.7;ctx.stroke();
if(ht>13){let rows=Math.min(7,Math.floor(ht/16)),cols=2;for(let row=0;row<rows;row++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){let fy=(row+1)/(rows+1),fx=(c+1)/(cols+1);let frontX=x+dx*(1-fx),frontY=y-ht+dy*fx+ht*fy;ctx.fillStyle=b.hp<.35?'#ff8b6044':(row+c+b.shade)%4===0?'#ffe6a1aa':'#a9d8e044';ctx.fillRect(frontX-1,frontY,2,Math.max(2,Math.min(4,ht/25)))}}
if(b.hp<.65&&b.hp>0){ctx.fillStyle='#ff8b4b';ctx.globalAlpha=.35+Math.sin(now/160+b.seed)*.2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y-ht-2,dx*.5,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=1}
}
// attack rings and bolts
for(const e of effects){let t=(now-e.start)/e.life;if(t>=1)continue;let p=project(e.x,e.y),fade=1-t;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=fade;ctx.strokeStyle=e.color;ctx.lineWidth=2+5*fade;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p[0],p[1],e.radius*sx*(.3+t*.9),e.radius*sy*(.3+t*.9),0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle=e.color;ctx.globalAlpha=.12*fade;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p[0],p[1],e.radius*sx*t,e.radius*sy*t,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();if(e.type==='storm'){ctx.globalAlpha=fade;ctx.strokeStyle='#b9f4ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){let target=buildings[(e.index+j*17)%buildings.length],q=target?project(target.x,target.y):p;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]-80);ctx.lineTo(p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*.48+Math.sin(now*.04+j)*9,p[1]-36);ctx.lineTo(q[0],q[1]-30);ctx.stroke()}}if(e.type==='meteor'){ctx.fillStyle='#ff9f61';ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.55;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p[0],p[1]-60+Math.sin(t*5)*18,9*(1-t),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore()}
for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=particles[i],t=(now-p.start)/p.life;if(t>=1){particles.splice(i,1);continue}ctx.globalAlpha=1-t;ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x+p.vx*t*38,p.y+p.vy*t*38+25*t*t,Math.max(.5,p.size*(1-t)),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=1}
if(pointer){let [px,py]=project(pointer.x,pointer.y);ctx.strokeStyle=weapons[selected].color+'cc';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,12,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.moveTo(px-19,py);ctx.lineTo(px-6,py);ctx.moveTo(px+6,py);ctx.lineTo(px+19,py);ctx.moveTo(px,py-19);ctx.lineTo(px,py-6);ctx.moveTo(px,py+6);ctx.lineTo(px,py+19);ctx.stroke()}
requestAnimationFrame(draw)}

## DIVINITÀ

Un piccolo gioco arcade browser-based: scegli uno dei quattro poteri cosmici e clicca/tocca gli edifici di Nova Aurelia per scatenarlo. Accumula punti, crea combo e osserva la città trasformarsi.

- **Meteora**: impatto devastante.
- **Tempesta**: fulmini a catena.
- **Vortice**: risucchio gravitazionale ad area.
- **Nova**: onda d’urto radiale.

L’energia si rigenera col tempo. Usa i tasti **1–4** per selezionare un potere e **R** per ricostruire la città. I suoni opzionali si attivano con l’icona musicale. Apri `index.html` in un browser moderno per giocare; non servono dipendenze o installazioni.

Include **Meteora, Tempesta, Vortice e Nova**, energia che si rigenera, combo, punteggio, effetti visivi, suoni opzionali e la possibilità di ricostruire la città. Funziona anche su dispositivi mobili e non richiede installazioni: apri `index.html` in un browser. Le istruzioni sono in `README.md`.
